title: Ellenial · Free tools for everyday life
meta_description: Tools that make life easier. Free and private. No ads, no trackers, no paywalls.
hero_eyebrow: Tiny tools, real difference. Completely free.
hero_title: Tools that make life easier. Free and private.
hero_lead: Use whatever you like. Nothing to pay, no tracking and no data sold on – what you write is encrypted on your phone and never appears as readable text in any database.
lib_lead:
The Ellenial portfolio is a work in progress. Check back here for the latest updates.
Lunch, Quiz and Weather are in alpha: tap a card to try it. Gillefeeling is in alpha with friends, and several other apps are in early alpha.
gf_desc: Plan get-togethers with family and friends, either starting from a ready-made idea or by finding a date that works for everyone.
split_desc: Split shared costs fast and easy.
why_p1: I got tired of using apps that promise to never share or sell my data, but then have micro-transactions for basic features, unreasonably high costs, or can only be used with a subscription. I've literally spent hours unchecking hundreds of trackers and cookies just to use a “free” app.
why_p2: Technology is growing fast, and AI is here to stay, so I started exploring the possibilities myself. Setting hard lines was the easiest part: no AI-generated art, no paywalls, as little stored private data as possible (lower costs and lower risks) and, if it's ever needed, always encrypted. Then a question came up: is this even possible?
why_p3: I started building an app for myself to understand the limits and the possibilities, and guess what, I was surprised! I realised I could make something out of this and make my days easier! That's where the idea was born to go public, not to make money, but to give something back. It's a small niche, but hopefully it can add something to your everyday life too.
receipt_title: What it costs to run, in the open.
receipt_lead: Breaking even is the goal, never profit. If the costs grow, you'll see it here first.
v1_text: Every tool is free. If you'd like to chip in, it's on your terms.
v2_text: Nobody is watching what you do, and there's nothing to sell.
v3_text: Anything that leaves your phone is encrypted there first. Not even I can read it.
v4_text: Every published tool shares its code, so you can see exactly how it works.
v5_title: Made by me, with the help of AI
v5_text: The art, the care and the decisions are mine. AI helps me write the code.
v6_text: The receipt above is updated every month. Making profits will never be the goal.
idea_title: Have an idea for a new app?
idea_lead: Tell me! The best small tools start with someone saying “I wish there was an app for this.”
idea_message: Oh, you found it! I'm thinking about how to receive ideas and feedback. Several options cost money, and I'm still figuring out what to do. Check back soon ❤️
footer_counter: On this page: an automatic counter shows the number of unique visits, anonymously of course.
weather_desc: Combination of weather services in Gothenburg, including historical data, frost, UV and sunny days.
maps_desc: Maps for unwinding: green spaces and social places, with a dog mode you can switch on and off.
lunch_desc: Shows Lindholmen lunch places and adjoining areas. With a simple planning tool for bringing colleagues and friends.
party_desc: Party games for the whole family, where several are usable offline.
quiz_desc: Quizzes to play together, on one shared screen or on your own phones. Make your own.
poll_desc: Easy polling tool for simple polling purposes.

thanks_lead: My apps are built on free and open work by other people: maps, weather data, photos, fonts and code. These are the ones they use. If you'd like to give something back, the support links go straight to them.
thanks_libraries: Each app also builds on smaller open-source libraries; you'll find them in each app's code on GitHub.
thanks_drawings_text: The hand-drawn icons in the apps are drawn by me, not by AI. They're all in one place, free to use for non-commercial projects as long as you credit Ellenial (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
thanks_paid: Paid services, like hosting, the database and the AI that helps me write the code, aren't listed here. Paying for them is my thanks, and you'll find them on the receipt.
